newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-C-C Amatil continues post-result slide.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-C-C Amatil continues post-result slide.

text.p: Shares in beverage maker Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd continued to slip on Tuesday following the release of its results for calendar 1996 after the close of trade on Friday.
At 10.15 (2315 GMT), Coca Cola-Amatil shares were 74 cents or 5.7 percent lower at A$12.20 on turnover of 216,088 shares.
"It's continuing its sell-down as the market continues to analyse the results," said Jamie Spiteri, a dealer at Sydney firm, Shaw Stockbroking.
The company, about 36 percent owned by The Coca-Cola Co, reported a slight rise in net profit to A$142.1 million for the 1996 year, compared with A$138.6 million a year earlier.
The shares have fallen from a high of A$18.15 set in September before it issued a profit forecast downgrade in November.
